pages.text: The Refrigerator cools cellars and cold storage. Place it in a valid structure and supply power. It only lowers temperature, stores a fixed set temperature in cold storage, and never raises naturally colder air.
The default recipe requires Immersive Engineering. The Refrigerator uses the standard Forge Energy capability.

pages.title: Operating Parameters
pages.text: Stores 4000000 FE and accepts up to 4096 FE/t. $(br2)It starts above 25% energy and preserves stored energy when broken.

pages.title: Cold Storage Tiers
pages.text: Sealed-brick cold storage reaches -15°C, uses 1.1x power, and provides up to 4.5x preservation. $(br2)Stainless steel reinforced cold storage reaches -30°C, uses 1.0x power, and provides up to 10x preservation. $(br2)Mixed storage averages the minimum temperature by thermal wall counts; its power tier uses the most common material.

pages.title: Preservation
pages.text: Actual temperature determines preservation: 2x at or above 0°C and 2.5x below 0°C. $(br2)At -6, -9, -12, -15, -18, -21, -24, -27, and -30°C, it is 3x, 3.5x, 4x, 4.5x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8.5x, and 10x. $(br2)Supported TFC, FirmaLife, and Immersive Engineering containers synchronize and clean up cellar preservation.
